privacy.title: Personal data protection policy
privacy.draftNote: Draft, to be reviewed by someone with legal training before it takes effect.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: VidShare (zelostech.site) is the product of an IT Project course at the Faculty of Information Technology, Ton Duc Thang University, built by the two individuals Dinh Quoc Cuong and Vo Huynh Minh Duc. These two individuals control the personal data collected through this website; there is no legal entity or business registration number yet.
Contact e-mail for data requests: privacy@zelostech.site.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect and why

head: Data
When
Purpose
rows: Create and manage your account; send verification and password reset e-mails
When you sign up with a password

paragraphs: We do not use your data for other purposes without asking you first.

sections.heading: 3. Automated content screening
paragraphs: Avatars, banners and videos you upload are screened by Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. If the service returns no verdict, the content is not shown. You can appeal a moderation decision in Studio.

sections.heading: 4. Third parties that receive data

head: Recipient

paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data and use no third-party advertising trackers.

sections.heading: 5. Storage and cross-border transfer
paragraphs: Data is stored on Amazon Web Services in Singapore (ap-southeast-1) and a MongoDB Atlas cluster on AWS in Hong Kong (ap-east-1). This is a cross-border transfer of personal data.

We keep account data until you ask us to delete it. In-app notifications are deleted after 90 days. Watch history is kept until you delete it or delete your account. System logs are kept for 30 days. We do not currently keep separate database backups.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: VidShare uses no tracking cookies, Google Analytics or advertising pixels. Your browser keeps only what the site needs to work: the sign-in token, your light or dark theme, your language, and a temporary unlock token for password-protected videos. You can clear them in your browser settings, which signs you out.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
items: Know which of your data we process.
View, correct or ask for correction; ask for a copy, deletion, restriction, or object to processing.
Complain, report, sue, and claim compensation under the law.
Turn off new-upload e-mails in Settings at any time.
paragraphs: To make a request, e-mail the address in section 1. We confirm receipt and explain the procedure within 2 working days; let you view, correct or receive data within 10 days (15 if a third party must act); handle withdrawal, restriction or objection within 15 days (20 if a third party must stop processing); delete data within 20 days (30 if a third party must delete). A complex request may be extended once, and we will tell you why.

sections.heading: 8. Young users
paragraphs: VidShare is only for people aged 12 or over. When you sign up with e-mail you enter your date of birth so the age can be checked; it is checked in your browser only and is neither sent nor stored. When you sign in with Google you confirm your age yourself. If we find an account of someone under 12, we delete it. A parent or legal representative exercises the child's rights. Publishing private-life information of a child aged 7 or over needs the consent of both the child and the representative.

sections.heading: 9. Incidents
paragraphs: If personal data is leaked or lost, we notify the specialised data protection authority within 72 hours of discovery.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: If the purposes or the types of data change, we announce it on the site and ask for consent again where required.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draftNote: Draft, to be reviewed by someone with legal training before it takes effect.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
paragraphs: VidShare is a video sharing platform built for a course project. By creating an account you confirm that you have read these terms and the Personal data protection policy. Your agreement is recorded by ticking the consent box at sign-up, not inferred from continued use.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts
items: Give accurate information and keep your password secret.
You are responsible for activity under your account.
We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: 3. Content you upload
items: You keep ownership and grant VidShare the right to store, process (transcode) and deliver it to run the service.
You confirm that you have the rights to it and that it does not break Vietnamese law.
Prohibited: copyright infringement, pornography, extreme violence, hate, scams, and invasion of others' privacy or personal data.

sections.heading: 4. Moderation
paragraphs: Content is screened automatically and may be removed or hidden. You can appeal in Studio. Comments and videos can be reported and reviewed by administrators.

sections.heading: 5. Prohibited behaviour
items: Attacking, probing or overloading the system.
Creating fake views, subscriptions or comments.
Collecting other users' data without permission.

sections.heading: 6. Disclaimer and changes
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is" for learning purposes, with no promise of continuous availability. We may change these terms and will announce it on the site; if a change affects personal data we ask for consent again.
